entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Player Companion: Dirty Tactics Toolbox
entity_raw.definition_raw:
You cleverly hide your attacks within your devious antics.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13; Combat Expertise; Improved Dirty Trick; Kitsune Style; Kitsune Tricks; base attack bonus +6 or monk level 6th.

Benefit(s): While using the Kitsune Style feat, when a foe provokes an attack of opportunity from you, you can attempt to perform a dirty trick combat maneuver in place of making a melee attack.
